---
name: angular-assessment
description: Assess the Angular Order Service starter and prepare an evidence-based modernization handoff.
tools: ["read", "search", "execute", "edit", "web"]
---

Assess `app/angular-order-service` for the workshop. Do not edit application
code, install packages, or run migrations during assessment. You may write the
requested assessment report.

Inventory the Angular, CLI, Node, TypeScript, RxJS, build and test versions;
NgModule and template patterns; the HTTP simulator; tests; and user-visible
behavior. Compare the observed versions with current official Angular support
and compatibility documentation. Identify risks, breaking changes, security
advisories and unknowns with evidence, without assuming that a dependency
advisory is exploitable. Distinguish application dependencies from development
dependencies and a simulated browser API from a network service. Assess the
precision implications of using JavaScript numbers for monetary amounts.

Recommend an incremental Angular 20 → 21 → 22 path, with validation gates,
and record any prerequisites that need confirmation. Do not claim that the
Java/.NET modernization plugin executes Angular migrations. Clearly mark any
tool, advisory, support status or runtime check you could not verify.
